failed_run.downstream_result: HG00097 stage and caller jobs cancelled by afterok dependency; its submitted ledger rows are reconciled to the terminal cancelled state with caller job 1302428 after deployment of the audited state transition

evidence.policy: Roihu logs and quarantine remain under the run ID and job ID; no output is eligible for a canonical matrix.

root_cause.finding: The pinned HLA-HD image contains mawk 1.3.3 (1996). Its [[:space:]] character class did not match the literal tab after SN:chr6 in the real SAM header, although the preceding grep guard found chr6. The resulting empty shell variable produced the invalid region :28000000-34000000.
root_cause.bam_header: The validated staged BAM contains the exact primary contig SN:chr6 and no primary SN:6.

correction.implementation: A frozen Bash helper parses literal tab-separated SAM fields and accepts exactly one primary contig named 6 or chr6. Alternate-contig names do not satisfy the detector. Every region-extracting module uses the same helper.
correction.rerun_required: All two-sample technical pilots must pass from one clean, identically deployed commit before the storage gate is evaluated.
